title: The Instructions
base_prompt: Colored stick figure, red shirt, blue pants, round white head, clean ink outlines, flat bright rooms.

characters.Hero: colored stick figure, red shirt, blue pants

scenes.vo: Okay. Easy one. Grab the salt shaker...
scenes.image_prompt: Stick figure sits at a kitchen table with a coffee mug, salt shaker and sugar bowl; he grabs the shaker and salts the coffee. Instructor speaker icon top right.

scenes.vo: ...and move it so you don't mix it up with the sugar.
scenes.image_prompt: He is still shaking salt into the mug, then freezes mid-shake with a thought-dots note.

scenes.vo: Two parts to that sentence. He did one.
scenes.image_prompt: Graphic: a sentence bar split into PART 1 (green, check) and PART 2 (grey); a yellow ball runs part 1 then hops off the bar.

scenes.vo: No problem. If anything goes in the wrong cup, pick up the spoon...
scenes.image_prompt: He grabs the spoon the second he hears it and stirs the salty coffee hard; coffee sloshes.

scenes.vo: ...and set it down. I'll bring you a fresh one.
scenes.image_prompt: Still stirring, he freezes with the spoon in the mug; thought-dots note.
He turns and stares at the camera, eyes wide, one sweat drop, slow blink.

scenes.vo: If you move before the sentence ends, same here.
scenes.image_prompt: Graphic: the same sentence bar; this time the ball waits, then runs the whole bar and gets a check.

scenes.vo: What helps me: let them finish the sentence. Then pick up the spoon.
scenes.image_prompt: Calm figure at the table, hands folded, waits, then picks up the spoon with a fresh cup.
